austrianpainter.settings.title: Austrian Painter
austrianpainter.settings.dungeon.desc: Catacombs rooms move and rotate every run, so paint made inside one is stored relative to the room and re-projected when you walk back in. Boss rooms are stored per floor as B1 to B7; master mode shares them.
austrianpainter.settings.room_scope.desc: Off means paint is always stored at world coordinates, which will not survive a new dungeon run.
austrianpainter.settings.rescan.desc: Throws away the scanned layout and rebuilds it. Use if a room is not recognised.
austrianpainter.settings.unbind_room_typ: Drops the block-type preset bound to the room you are standing in, so it falls back to the world's.
austrianpainter.settings.unbind_room_blo: Drops the block preset bound to the room you are standing in, so it falls back to the world's.
austrianpainter.settings.unbind_room_pal: Drops the palette preset bound to the room you are standing in, so it falls back to the default.
austrianpainter.settings.device.desc: The phase-2 device pillars are diorite. This renders them as the colour of the array they belong to without touching the world, so the pillars keep moving and the colour follows them. Note that with the painted overlay on, an arena full of painted pillars will hit its outline cap.
austrianpainter.settings.zones.desc: Repaints five fixed zones in the F7/M7 Sadan boss room: the moving pillar blocks (coal block, player head), and the sea lantern/obsidian, redstone lamp lit/unlit, sea lantern/blue terracotta and emerald/blue terracotta panels. Each source block picks its own donor or palette independently.
austrianpainter.settings.show_hud.desc: Draws the armed donor and brush size in the corner while the brush is on.
austrianpainter.settings.paint_sound.des: Painted blocks take the donor's break and step sounds instead of their own.
austrianpainter.settings.brush_radius.de: 1 paints a single block. Larger sizes paint a cube of side 2r-1, up to %1$sx%1$sx%1$s.
austrianpainter.settings.show_hints.desc: Adds the brush-resize gesture to the HUD readout while the brush is on. Turn off once it is second nature.
austrianpainter.settings.show_looking_at: Adds the real block under your crosshair to the HUD readout - never the painted-over block.
austrianpainter.settings.keybinds_enable: Turns off every Austrian Painter keybind (paint, erase, corners, undo/redo, menu, overlay toggle). The bindings stay visible in Controls, they just do nothing while off.
austrianpainter.settings.area_outline.de: Colour of the box edges drawn around the area selection.
austrianpainter.settings.area_fill.desc: Colour of the translucent box body. Keep the alpha low so the area stays readable.
austrianpainter.settings.active_blocks.d: Which set of painted coordinates this world uses.
austrianpainter.settings.active_types.de: Which whole-block-type palette this world uses.
Which donor palette an area replace draws from. Shared by every world.
